'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Mercenary, are you ready for some serious work? The matter is quite significant and requires high preparation. So, listen: the BEAR PMC operatives have been radically interfering with operations on the coast near the Lighthouse lately. I think you have already encountered them there and may have noticed their increased activity. Your task is to help us to maintain the position of the UN in this city ... Are you well prepared? Eliminating BEAR is not the same as scaring off regular bandits.}}

==Requirements==
* This quest is only obtainable by [[USEC]] PMCs.
* Must be level 30 to start this quest.
* Must be Loyalty Level 4 to start this quest

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 20 [[BEAR]] PMC operatives on [[Lighthouse]], [[Ground Zero]], [[Reserve]], [[Shoreline]], or [[Streets of Tarkov]]
* Hand over 20 found [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]] [[BEAR]] [[Dogtag|PMC dogtags]]

==Rewards==
* +65,000[[EXP]]
*[[Peacekeeper]] Rep <font color="green">'''+1.5'''</font>
* 2,300 Dollars
** 2,415 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 3,368 Dollars with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
* 1x [[AFAK tactical individual first aid kit]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[AFAK tactical individual first aid kit]] at [[Peacekeeper]] LL4
* +2 levels in [[Aim Drills]]
* +4 levels in [[Submachine Guns]]
{{quote|I hope you understand that such an assignment is not given to just anyone. But the reward is appropriate. Here's what you've earned.}}
